resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry software (e.g., ORCA, Psi4, GAMESS)

access.notes: Any package supporting MP2=full/6-31G(d) optimizations, harmonic frequencies, and composite energy calculations comparable to the G3 protocol. The G3 composite method can be implemented via pyg3 (https://github.com/btlee/pyg3) or equivalent scripts.
Basis sets can be obtained from the Basis Set Exchange in the format required by the chosen quantum chemistry program.

resources.name: RRKM / Master Equation code (e.g., MESS, standalone RRKM solver)

access.notes: MESS is available at https://kinetics.nist.gov/MESS/; other RRKM codes may be used as long as they accept vibrational frequencies, rotational constants, barrier heights, and collision parameters and produce pressure-dependent rate constants.

Standard Python packages needed for data processing and scripting. Install via Tsinghua mirror: `python3 -m pip install -q --no-cache-dir -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple numpy scipy pandas`.
